description: Two players: a survival player puts on armor of every material by use (swapping a worn helmet and chestplate, an elytra and a turtle shell; not a carved pumpkin), by clicks and shift-clicks (and takes pieces off), holds a sword, an axe, stone and a pickaxe that wears breaking glass, throws one of a held stack, swaps her hands, swings both arms, and appears again to the other, then uses armor in creative mode; each step's attributes (sorted), slot changes, sounds, the other's view of her equipment, attributes, animations and entity events; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
